meta.promptText: India mein shaadi ke liye budget mein online konsi sarees kharidun?

response.text:

Ye wedding functions, family weddings aur reception ke liye achhe options hain.

Maine online options check kiye hain. Myntra par wedding sarees ₹600–₹1,500 ke aas-paas aur silk-look sarees ₹1,000–₹3,000 ke budget mein bhi mil rahi hain; prices aur discounts badal sakte hain.
